text_en: After two whole years, Pharaoh dreamed that he was standing by the Nile,
text_cn: 过了两年，法郎作了一梦，梦见自己站在尼罗河畔。

text_en: and there came up out of the Nile seven sleek and fat cows, and they grazed in the reed grass.
text_cn: 看见从尼罗河中上来了七只母牛，色美体肥，在芦苇中吃草。

text_en: Then seven other cows, ugly and thin, came up out of the Nile after them, and stood by the other cows on the bank of the Nile.
text_cn: 随后，从尼罗河中，又上来了七只色丑体瘦的母牛，站在尼罗河岸上靠近那些母牛身旁。

text_en: The ugly and thin cows ate up the seven sleek and fat cows. And Pharaoh awoke.
text_cn: 这些色丑体瘦的母牛，竟将那七只色美体肥的母牛吞了下去；法郎便惊醒了。

text_en: Then he fell asleep and dreamed a second time; seven ears of grain, plump and good, were growing on one stalk.
text_cn: 他又睡下，作了一个梦，梦见在一根麦茎上，生出了七枝又肥又美的麦穗；

text_en: Then seven ears, thin and blighted by the east wind, sprouted after them.
text_cn: 随后，又发出了七枝又细弱，而又为东风吹焦了的麦穗。

text_en: The thin ears swallowed up the seven plump and full ears. Pharaoh awoke, and it was a dream.
text_cn: 这些细弱的麦穗竟将那七枝又肥又实的麦穗吞了下去。法郎惊醒了，原是一场梦。

text_en: In the morning his spirit was troubled; so he sent and called for all the magicians of Egypt and all its wise men. Pharaoh told them his dreams, but there was no one who could interpret them to Pharaoh.
text_cn: 到了早晨，他心烦意乱，遂遣人将埃及所有的术士和贤士召来，给他们讲述了自己的梦，却没有人能给法郎解释。

text_en: Then the chief cupbearer said to Pharaoh, “I remember my faults today.
text_cn: 那时司酒长向法郎说：“我今天想起了我的过犯。

text_en: Once Pharaoh was angry with his servants, and put me and the chief baker in custody in the house of the captain of the guard.
text_cn: 有一次陛下对自己的臣仆发怒，将我和司厨长关在卫队长府内的拘留所内。

text_en: We dreamed on the same night, he and I, each having a dream with its own meaning.
text_cn: 我和他在同一夜里，各作了一梦，我们每人的梦都有它的意义。

text_en: A young Hebrew was there with us, a servant of the captain of the guard. When we told him, he interpreted our dreams to us, giving an interpretation to each according to his dream.
text_cn: 在那里有个希伯来少年人与我们在一起，他是卫队长的仆人；当我们把梦告诉了他，他就给我们加以解释，给每个人的梦都说明了它的意义。

text_en: As he interpreted to us, so it turned out; I was restored to my office, and the baker was hanged. ”
text_cn: 果然，都照他给我们所解释的应验了：我恢复了原职，他却被吊死了。”

text_en: Then Pharaoh sent for Joseph, and he was hurriedly brought out of the dungeon. When he had shaved himself and changed his clothes, he came in before Pharaoh.
text_cn: 法郎于是遣人去召若瑟，人就快把他从地牢里提出来；他剃了头，刮了脸，换了衣服，来到法郎跟前。

text_en: And Pharaoh said to Joseph, “I have had a dream, and there is no one who can interpret it. I have heard it said of you that when you hear a dream you can interpret it. ”
text_cn: 法郎对若瑟说：“我作了一梦，没有人能够解释。我听见人说，你听了梦就能解释。”

text_en: Joseph answered Pharaoh, “It is not I; God will give Pharaoh a favorable answer. ”
text_cn: 若瑟回答法郎说：“这不是我所能的，只有天主能给陛下一个吉祥的解答。”

text_en: Then Pharaoh said to Joseph, “In my dream I was standing on the banks of the Nile;
text_cn: 法郎遂向若瑟说：“我梦见我站在尼罗河上，

text_en: and seven cows, fat and sleek, came up out of the Nile and fed in the reed grass.
text_cn: 看见从河中上来了七只母牛，体肥色美，在芦苇丛中吃草。

text_en: Then seven other cows came up after them, poor, very ugly, and thin. Never had I seen such ugly ones in all the land of Egypt.
text_cn: 随后，又上来了七只母牛，软弱无力，色丑体瘦，那种丑陋，我在埃及全国从未见过。

text_en: The thin and ugly cows ate up the first seven fat cows,
text_cn: 这些又瘦又丑的母牛，竟将先上来的那七只肥母牛吞了下去。

text_en: but when they had eaten them no one would have known that they had done so, for they were still as ugly as before. Then I awoke.
text_cn: 它们吞下去之后，竟看不出来它们吞了下去，因为它们丑陋的样子和先前一样，我就惊醒了。

text_en: I fell asleep a second time and I saw in my dream seven ears of grain, full and good, growing on one stalk,
text_cn: 以后我又梦见在一根麦茎上，生出了七枝粗大美丽的麦穗。

text_en: and seven ears, withered, thin, and blighted by the east wind, sprouting after them;
text_cn: 随后，又发出了七枝枯萎细弱而又被东风吹焦了的麦穗。

text_en: and the thin ears swallowed up the seven good ears. But when I told it to the magicians, there was no one who could explain it to me. ”
text_cn: 这些细弱的麦穗竟将那七枝美丽的麦穗吞了。我讲给了术士们听，但没有人能给我解说。”

text_en: Then Joseph said to Pharaoh, “Pharaoh’s dreams are one and the same; God has revealed to Pharaoh what he is about to do.
text_cn: 若瑟遂对法郎说：“陛下的梦只是一个。天主已将所要作的告诉陛下：

text_en: The seven good cows are seven years, and the seven good ears are seven years; the dreams are one.
text_cn: 七只美好的母牛表示七年，七枝美好的麦穗也表示七年。这原是一个梦。

text_en: The seven lean and ugly cows that came up after them are seven years, as are the seven empty ears blighted by the east wind. They are seven years of famine.
text_cn: 随后上来的那七只又瘦又丑的母牛，和那七枝空虚而又被东风吹焦了的麦穗，都表示七年，表示将有七个荒年。

text_en: It is as I told Pharaoh; God has shown to Pharaoh what he is about to do.
text_cn: 这即是我对陛下所说：天主已将他要作的显示给陛下了。

text_en: There will come seven years of great plenty throughout all the land of Egypt.
text_cn: 看埃及全国将有七年大丰收。

text_en: After them there will arise seven years of famine, and all the plenty will be forgotten in the land of Egypt; the famine will consume the land.
text_cn: 继之而来的是七个荒年，那时人都忘记了埃及国曾有过丰收。当饥荒蹂躏此地时，

text_en: The plenty will no longer be known in the land because of the famine that will follow, for it will be very grievous.
text_cn: 谁也觉不到此地曾有过丰收，因为相继而来的饥荒实在太严重了。

text_en: And the doubling of Pharaoh’s dream means that the thing is fixed by God, and God will shortly bring it about.
text_cn: 至于陛下的梦重复了两次，是表示这事已由天主命定，天主就快要实行。

text_en: Now therefore let Pharaoh select a man who is discerning and wise, and set him over the land of Egypt.
text_cn: 所以陛下现在应当寻找一个聪明，有智慧的人，派他管理埃及国。

text_en: Let Pharaoh proceed to appoint overseers over the land, and take one-fifth of the produce of the land of Egypt during the seven plenteous years.
text_cn: 陛下应设法在地方上派定督办，在七个丰年内，征收埃及国所出产的五分之一；

text_en: Let them gather all the food of these good years that are coming, and lay up grain under the authority of Pharaoh for food in the cities, and let them keep it.
text_cn: 使他们将未来丰年内的一切食粮，聚敛起来，将五谷都储藏在陛下手下，贮在城内备作食粮，妥为保管。

text_en: That food shall be a reserve for the land against the seven years of famine that are to befall the land of Egypt, so that the land may not perish through the famine. ”
text_cn: 这些食粮应作为本地的存粮，以应付那在埃及国要出现的七个荒年，免得全国因饥荒而灭亡。”

text_en: The proposal pleased Pharaoh and all his servants.
text_cn: 这番话使法郎和他的群臣十分赞成，

text_en: Pharaoh said to his servants, “Can we find anyone else like this—one in whom is the spirit of God? ”
text_cn: 于是法郎对他的臣仆说：“像他这样的人，有天主的神住在他内，我们岂能找着另一个？”

text_en: So Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Since God has shown you all this, there is no one so discerning and wise as you.
text_cn: 法郎遂对若瑟说：“天主既使你知道这一切，就再没有像你这样聪敏富有智慧的人了。

text_en: You shall be over my house, and all my people shall order themselves as you command; only with regard to the throne will I be greater than you. ”
text_cn: 你要掌管我的朝廷，我的人民都要听从你的号令；只在宝座上我比你大。”

text_en: And Pharaoh said to Joseph, “See, I have set you over all the land of Egypt. ”
text_cn: 法郎又对若瑟说：“看，我立你统治全埃及国。”

text_en: Removing his signet ring from his hand, Pharaoh put it on Joseph’s hand; he arrayed him in garments of fine linen, and put a gold chain around his neck.
text_cn: 遂由自己手上取下打印的戒指，戴在若瑟手上，给他穿上细麻长袍，将金链戴在他的颈项上；

text_en: He had him ride in the chariot of his second-in-command; and they cried out in front of him, “Bow the knee! ” Thus he set him over all the land of Egypt.
text_cn: 又使他坐在自己的第二部御车上，人们在他前面喊说：“跪下！”法郎就这样立他管理全埃及国。

text_en: Moreover Pharaoh said to Joseph, “I am Pharaoh, and without your consent no one shall lift up hand or foot in all the land of Egypt. ”
text_cn: 法郎又对若瑟说：“我是法郎，没有你的同意，全埃及国，任何人不得做任何事。”

text_en: Pharaoh gave Joseph the name Zaphenath-paneah; and he gave him Asenath daughter of Potiphera, priest of On, as his wife. Thus Joseph gained authority over the land of Egypt.
text_cn: 法郎给若瑟起名叫匝斐纳特帕乃亚，又将翁城的司祭颇提斐辣的女儿阿斯纳特给他为妻。若瑟便出去巡行埃及全国。

text_en: Joseph was thirty years old when he entered the service of Pharaoh king of Egypt. And Joseph went out from the presence of Pharaoh, and went through all the land of Egypt.
text_cn: 若瑟立于埃及王法郎前时，年三十岁。他由法郎面前出去巡行了埃及全国。

text_en: During the seven plenteous years the earth produced abundantly.
text_cn: 七个丰年内，土地出产极其丰富。

text_en: He gathered up all the food of the seven years when there was plenty in the land of Egypt, and stored up food in the cities; he stored up in every city the food from the fields around it.
text_cn: 若瑟聚敛了埃及国七个丰年内所有的粮食，积蓄在城内；每城城郊田间所出的粮食，也都储藏在本城内。

text_en: So Joseph stored up grain in such abundance—like the sand of the sea—that he stopped measuring it; it was beyond measure.
text_cn: 这样若瑟聚敛了大量的五谷，多得有如海沙，无法计算，无法胜数。

text_en: Before the years of famine came, Joseph had two sons, whom Asenath daughter of Potiphera, priest of On, bore to him.
text_cn: 在荒年未来以前，若瑟已有了两个儿子，是翁城的司祭颇提斐辣的女儿阿斯纳特给他生的。

text_en: Joseph named the firstborn Manasseh, “For, ” he said, “God has made me forget all my hardship and all my father’s house. ”
text_cn: 若瑟给长子起名叫默纳协，说：“天主使我忘尽了我的一切困苦和我父的全家。”

text_en: The second he named Ephraim, “For God has made me fruitful in the land of my misfortunes. ”
text_cn: 给次子起名叫厄弗辣因，说：“天主使我在我受苦的地方有了子息。”

text_en: The seven years of plenty that prevailed in the land of Egypt came to an end;
text_cn: 埃及国的七个丰年一过，

text_en: and the seven years of famine began to come, just as Joseph had said. There was famine in every country, but throughout the land of Egypt there was bread.
text_cn: 七个荒年随着就来了，恰如若瑟所预言的；各地都发生了饥荒，唯独全埃及国还有食粮。

text_en: When all the land of Egypt was famished, the people cried to Pharaoh for bread. Pharaoh said to all the Egyptians, “Go to Joseph; what he says to you, do. ”
text_cn: 及至埃及全国闹饥荒时，人民便向法郎呼求粮食；法郎对埃及民众说：“你们到若瑟那里去，照他对你们所说的做。”

text_en: And since the famine had spread over all the land, Joseph opened all the storehouses, and sold to the Egyptians, for the famine was severe in the land of Egypt.
text_cn: 当时饥荒弥漫天下，若瑟便开了国内所有的粮仓，将粮食卖给埃及人，因为埃及的饥荒很严重。

text_en: Moreover, all the world came to Joseph in Egypt to buy grain, because the famine became severe throughout the world.
text_cn: 天下的人都来到埃及，向若瑟购买食粮，因为天下各地都大闹饥荒。
